correctness.rationale: The affine normalization is valid for all positive-base planar trapezoids. Exact slice formulas cover every point and boundary; the top pair covers every y>=1-beta for beta>=1/2 and the bottom pair leaves precisely the stated triangular gap below it. An explicit long-base gap handles lambda<1. The integrated triangle gives the exact affine-invariant area formula; the t=1 endpoint is separately proved. A standalone rational verifier passed 39,919 finite checks, which are not substituted for the analytic proof.

value.rationale: This gives the complete sharp Schneider-index classification of all one-parameter affine classes of planar trapezoids, from parallelograms to the triangular degeneracy, and a strictly stronger exact missing-area law with quadratic critical exponent. The gap geometry and scaling quantify the transition absent from bare finiteness and dimension-bound theorems; it is a natural family and invariant rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
